title: Componentes da Carta de Aventureiro

sourceReview.fidelityNote: The official PDF raster and current English Viewer/one-page export were compared full-page. The card illustration, stat symbols, callout markers, 37 text blocks, ten image regions and folio are present. Character name, values and callout letters are preserved; editable labels and explanatory prose are proposed.
